items.title: OpenAI 不再直接拿“活网页”训练：模型会少一条最新信息入口
items.brief: 以后 AI 想跟上刚发生的新闻，可能更依赖授权数据、搜索和用户主动提供的内容。
items.take: OpenAI 表示将不再用实时互联网内容训练模型，理由是这种做法有“重大风险”。这不是说模型从此看不到网络信息，而是把“训练时吸收网页”与“回答时检索网页”分得更开。对用户而言，答案的新鲜度、出处和付费内容能否被使用，都会更受产品规则影响；对网站和媒体而言，谁能给 AI 喂数据、谁能获得回报，正在变成一笔更明确的生意。

训练数据与实时检索将更明显分开

en.title: OpenAI steps back from training on the live web, narrowing one route to fresh information
en.brief: AI may rely more on licensed data, search, and what users provide if it needs to keep up with new events.
en.take: OpenAI says it will no longer train its models on live internet content because of what it calls significant risks. That does not mean its products can never see web information; it more clearly separates training on pages from retrieving pages while answering. For users, freshness, sourcing, and access to paid material may depend more on product rules. For publishers, permission and payment for AI use of their work are becoming a much more concrete business question.

items.title: OpenAI 把“替你做取舍”的模型推向大众，AI 竞争从会答题走向会决定
items.brief: 这类模型瞄准的是多步选择，不只是写一段像样的文字。
items.take: OpenAI 将其对标 Jev 的决策模型更广泛开放。它主打的不是聊天更顺，而是在信息不完整、目标互相冲突时，帮人比较选项并给出行动建议。真正的门槛也在这里：一旦模型参与采购、排班、风控或个人财务取舍，错一次的代价远高于答错一道题。开放后，开发者会更容易把它接进工作流，但是否能解释理由、允许人随时接管，才决定它能走多远。

en.title: OpenAI broadens access to a model built to make trade-offs, not just write well
en.brief: These models target multi-step choices, not merely polished text generation.
en.take: OpenAI has made its Jev competitor more widely available. The pitch is not simply smoother chat: it is comparing options and suggesting action when information is incomplete and goals conflict. That is also where the stakes rise. A bad choice in purchasing, staffing, risk control, or personal finance costs more than a wrong answer to a question. Developers may find it easier to put the model into workflows, but explainability and a clear human override will determine how far it can go.

en.title: Anthropic wants Claude to do work, not just chat—and that puts permissions in the spotlight
en.brief: Claude Duet is built around agents that carry out tasks, bringing convenience and loss-of-control risks closer to users.
en.take: Anthropic has launched the Claude Duet app as a bet on agents: AI systems that can complete a chain of tasks for a person. The appeal is obvious—less switching among webpages, spreadsheets, and apps. But once an agent can sign in, send messages, or edit files, the question is no longer only whether its answer is correct. It is what it can touch, and who approves each step. This product race could turn permissions and activity logs from back-office IT details into settings ordinary users need to manage.

items.title: 油价冲上每桶117美元：中东再有一轮打击，先贵起来的可能是出行和运费
items.brief: 市场担心伊朗局势会卡住供应，油价已先替未来的风险买单。
items.take: 在美国可能恢复对伊朗打击的担忧下，油价升至每桶117美元以上。油价不是立刻原样传到加油站，但航空燃油、货运和化工原料都会先感到压力，之后才可能传到机票、物流费和部分商品价格。眼下最关键的不是一天的涨跌，而是冲突会不会持续威胁产油、运输路线和油轮安全；只要这个答案不清楚，市场就会继续给油价加一层“风险费”。

en.title: Oil tops $117 a barrel: another round of Middle East strikes could show up first in travel and freight costs
en.brief: Markets are already pricing in the risk that the Iran crisis could disrupt supply.
en.take: Oil rose above $117 a barrel amid fears that the US could renew strikes on Iran. Crude prices do not pass straight through to petrol stations overnight, but aviation fuel, shipping, and chemical inputs feel the pressure first; airfares, delivery costs, and some consumer prices can follow. The key question is not one day's move. It is whether conflict keeps threatening production, shipping routes, and tanker safety. Until that is clearer, the market is likely to keep adding a risk premium to oil.

en.title: Officials urge the US and Israel not to strike Iran again: the danger is a miscalculation that spreads
en.brief: This is more than diplomatic rhetoric; fresh strikes could put oil routes, shipping, and neighbouring states under pressure.
en.take: European and Middle Eastern officials have warned the US and Israel against fresh strikes on Iran. The public warning suggests fears go beyond one operation: retaliation, counter-retaliation, and miscalculation can become hard to stop once linked together. Far from the battlefield, the first visible effects may be energy prices, rerouted flights, shipping delays, and market volatility. Keeping communication channels open is more useful than another hard-line statement.

en.title: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case; tracing the source matters more than panic
en.brief: Now that a case has reached West Africa, finding the contact chain will show whether this is isolated or the start of something larger.
en.take: Nigeria has confirmed an Ebola case, while the source of infection remains unclear and concern is growing about wider spread. Ebola is not easily passed through ordinary casual contact; the critical issues are exposure to bodily fluids after symptoms begin, safe medical care, and fast cross-border tracing. The immediate priorities are mapping the patient's movements and contacts, protecting health workers, and sharing information with neighbouring countries. Travellers do not need to panic, but should follow formal public-health guidance.

en.title: Flaws in software used by roughly 70% of websites draw more hacker probing
en.brief: This is not just a small-site problem: slow patching can expose accounts, orders, and personal data.
en.take: NPR reports that hacking attempts are rising after vulnerabilities were found in software affecting about 70% of websites. The report does not say every site has been breached, but the scale makes the risk broad: online shops, booking systems, and company back ends often rely on similar underlying software. For users, watch for unusual login alerts and avoid reusing passwords on suspicious pages. Site operators need to check exposure and apply patches quickly. In security, the dangerous period is often after a flaw becomes public but before everyone fixes it.

items.title: 西藏7级地震已致至少16人遇难：救援先要穿过受损道路和高海拔
items.brief: 灾区的难题不止房屋倒塌，偏远和高海拔会让救援、通信和安置都更难。
items.take: 据报道，西藏发生7级地震，至少16人死亡，数百所房屋被毁。地震发生后的伤亡数字和损失范围仍可能变化，但高海拔、分散村落和道路受损会放大救援难度。此时最需要的是余震监测、通信恢复、临时安置与对受损建筑的排查。对公众而言，转发灾情时应优先看权威部门的最新通报，避免把尚未核实的失联和伤亡数字继续放大。

en.title: A magnitude-7 quake in Tibet has killed at least 16; rescue must contend with damaged roads and altitude
en.brief: The challenge is not only collapsed homes: remoteness and high altitude make rescue, communications, and shelter harder.
en.take: A magnitude-7 earthquake in Tibet has killed at least 16 people and destroyed hundreds of homes, according to reports. Casualty and damage figures may still change, but high altitude, scattered communities, and damaged roads can make relief much harder. The immediate needs are aftershock monitoring, restored communications, temporary shelter, and checks on damaged buildings. For the public, it is worth relying on the latest official updates rather than amplifying unverified casualty or missing-person figures.

items.title: 印度下调抗癌药价格：法院认定过高加价，病人终于可能少付一点
items.brief: 药价规则一改，最直接的变化是患者和家庭的治疗账单有机会降下来。
items.take: 印度在法院裁定部分加价属于“敲诈式”之后，下调抗癌药成本。对癌症患者来说，这类政策不是抽象的监管动作：药物能否负担，常常决定治疗是否中断、家庭是否举债。价格下调能否真正落到药房和医院账单上，仍取决于执行、供应和地区差异。它也再次提醒人们，专利、流通和零售加价这些看似遥远的环节，最后都会落到病人的付款单上。

en.title: India cuts cancer-drug costs after a court condemns excessive mark-ups; patients may finally pay less
en.brief: When drug-pricing rules change, the immediate difference can be a lower treatment bill for patients and families.
en.take: India has cut the cost of cancer drugs after a court ruled that some mark-ups were extortionate. For people with cancer, this is not an abstract regulatory move: whether treatment is affordable can decide whether it continues or leaves a family in debt. Whether the reduction fully reaches pharmacy and hospital bills will still depend on enforcement, supply, and regional differences. The move is also a reminder that patents, distribution, and retail mark-ups may look distant, but they end up on a patient's bill.

items.title: ConnectWise 被攻破后，数千家公司遭监视：供应商一失守，客户会一起暴露
items.brief: 企业把 IT 管理交给同一平台很省事，但攻击者也因此找到了更大的入口。
items.take: 报道称，中国黑客在攻破 IT 服务商 ConnectWise 后，监视了数千家公司。这类事件的棘手之处在于，攻击者不必逐家破解客户，只要进入替客户管理设备、更新软件或远程支持的供应商系统，就可能横向接触大量目标。对一般人，这类入侵未必立刻可见，却可能带来服务中断、数据泄露和账户重置。企业应重新检查外包 IT 权限、日志和多重验证，而不是只盯着自家网络大门。

en.title: After ConnectWise was breached, thousands of companies were reportedly watched: one supplier can expose many customers
en.brief: Centralizing IT management is convenient, but it also gives attackers a much larger doorway.
en.take: Chinese hackers reportedly spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT provider ConnectWise. The problem with an incident like this is that attackers do not need to break into every customer separately. If they get into a vendor that manages devices, software updates, or remote support, they may be able to reach many targets through that trusted channel. For ordinary people, the effect may not be visible at once, but can include outages, data exposure, and account resets. Companies need to review outsourced IT permissions, logs, and multi-factor authentication—not just their own perimeter.

An IT provider can reach many customers' systems and devices
impacts: Businesses
Overly broad outsourced-IT permissions can turn one failure into a supply-chain incident
